item.title: Patrick Stewart has died at age 86
item.description: Patrick Stewart, best known for his roles in Star Trek and X-Men, has died at age 86. A message posted to Stewart's Instagram account says the actor died in his Los Angeles home on Wednesday "following a brief and poignant journey with Alzheimer's Disease and Lewy Body Dementia." item.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
item.description: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.

item.title: Reddit will force everyone to log in
item.description: Reddit is announcing a huge shift: It's going to start requiring users to log in. item.title: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings acquires ADT
item.description: OpenAI-backed Thrive Holdings is buying ADT in a $15.3 billion deal, with plans to bring AI to the home security business.
